profile.name: Prof. K. Ramasubramanian
profile.designation: Professor-in-Charge, Centre for Traditional Indian Knowledge and Skills (CTIKS)
profile.biography: K. Ramasubramanian studies the history of Indian mathematics and astronomy through Sanskrit scientific literature. His work includes critical editions, translations and mathematical explanations of historical texts, alongside teaching and research on India’s knowledge traditions. He leads the Centre for Traditional Indian Knowledge and Skills at IIT Bombay.
researchTags: Kerala school of mathematics and astronomy
profile.researchTagsNote: Editorial labels derived from the narrative biography and research focus; professor should confirm terminology.
profile.researchOverview: Research combines scientific analysis and Sanskrit scholarship to study historical mathematical and astronomical texts. Related work includes critical editions and translations, digital research collections, and tools for manuscript preservation and Sanskrit text processing.
